implemented: New player-placed flower pots/lily pads initialize an optional invulnerableIn100 counter. Ordinary plant updates decrement it before the chew gate; first99 logic steps reject bite damage, step100 is edible.
Imitater transformation initializes the copied-base counter after that tick counter pass; it does not consume the base window during the imitater animation.
Initial roof pots and old saved bases without the optional field retain ordinary vulnerable behavior rather than inferring a new window from birth time.
Only the actual food target is protected: ordinary plants above a base are edible; vehicle crushing remains active.
Existing snapshot/restore carries the optional number. No new ticker, rendering object, asset, dependency or collection.
limits: Source uses an explicit plant state. The port uses one optional counter and does not reconstruct every plant state or bungee/ZenGarden update path.
Old saves from the former implementation do not contain enough state to reconstruct a missing partial protection window; absent fields keep former behavior.
No new browser-render or physical-device CPU/RAM proof. Logic tests are controlled, funded fixtures and do not certify normal-play completion.
Six current normal-play checks fail, including two failures reappearing after the source-backed protection change.
